---
title: "Introduction to R package development"
subtitle: "RaukR 2026, Wednesday August 12 (half day)"
---

## What we'll do

* **The Whole Game**: create a small package from scratch.
  Based on [this chapter of R Packages (2e)](https://r-pkgs.org/whole-game.html).
* **The Package Within**: extract a package from data analysis scripts.
  Based on [this chapter of R Packages (2e)](https://r-pkgs.org/package-within.html).

## Materials

* Slides: The Whole Game, in slide form, by Andy Teucher, prepared for
  posit::conf(2023). [PDF](../pkg-dev-2023.pdf)
* libminer, the example package we will build:
  <https://github.com/ateucher/libminer>
* Package development workshop from posit::conf(2023); the "Modules" provide
  prompts for various activities:
  <https://posit-conf-2023.github.io/pkg-dev/intro.html>

## Where to learn more

* R Packages, 2nd edition: <https://r-pkgs.org/>
